configuration.title: GitHub Copilot Completions
configuration.signInMethod.description: How the GitHub Copilot language server signs in to GitHub.
configuration.signInMethod.accounts: Use the GitHub account from the Accounts menu. The token is passed to the language server in memory.
configuration.signInMethod.languageServe: Sign in with the language server's own GitHub device flow. The language server stores the token in plaintext in its configuration directory, shared with other editors' Copilot plugins.
configuration.configDirectory.descriptio: Absolute path to use in place of `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` (default `~/.config`) for the language server's `github-copilot` folder, which holds its stored GitHub token. Only used when `#copilotCompletions.signInMethod#` is `languageServer`. Leave empty for the default.
